title.narrative: The second phase of securing shelter and rehabilitating homes damaged by the earthquake in Aleppo Governorate, Syrian Arab Republic

description.narrative: Rehabilitating and providing decent and appropriate shelter for families affected by the earthquake, by rehabilitating about 743 houses that were slightly or moderately damaged by the earthquake, and by providing about 31 temporary prefabricated housing units as an alternative to the severely damaged houses.

Rehabilitation of 743 houses that were slightly and moderately damaged by the earthquake, and provision of 31 temporary housing units for families whose homes were severely damaged. The project will benefit more than 4,450 people affected by the earthquake in Al-Bab city, Aleppo governorate, Syrian Arab Republic.

Rehabilitation of 743 houses to their pre-earthquake condition through general restoration of basic and service elements of the house, and replacement of 31 severely damaged houses with temporary housing units. The houses and temporary housing units will also be provided through the project with basic needs such as providing electricity through solar panels, installing modern water tanks, providing ventilation, etc.
